import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Completed the independent research and design specification for Property Card frontmatter takeover and the keyboard-first Property Editor: - **Report**: [property_card_frontmatter_takeover__gem.md](file:///home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/bobs-org/bob-cli/bob-cli_16/sase/repos/research/202611/property_card_frontmatter_takeover__gem.md) - **Registered SASE Artifact**: `explicit:b2d7788dff4f3963e34cd0f0` (`research:202611/property_card_frontmatter_takeover__gem.md`, stored at [property_card_frontmatter_takeover__gem-33d4e3b036ac.md](file:///home/bryan/.sase/artifacts/agents/gh_bobs-org__bob-cli/20261122120055/property_card_frontmatter_takeover__gem-33d4e3b036ac.md)) ### Verdict & Executive Summary **Strongly endorse the proposal, with six concrete adjustments.** Across the live `~/bob` vault (1,473 property-card notes across 7 species vs. 5,216 other frontmatter notes), taking over `.metadata-container` removes partial row-hiding clutter (and Record Sheet's current three-layer overlap of sheet rows + bespoke `▸ N other properties` fold + native Properties) while unlocking a fast, Vim-native Property Editor. ### Six Justified Requirement Adjustments Called Out in the Report 1. **Retire Record Sheet's bespoke fold & `created` `

`** (`242j-plugin-record-sheet-dom.js`) and unify all 7 species on one shared kit **Properties Footer Bar + Drawer**. 2. **Smart `created` readout right-aligned on the collapsed footer bar (0 px extra height)**: show `Created 6:43 AM` on same-day Day cards (166/175 modern dailies share the title date), `Created Jun 11, 2026` on backfilled dailies and other species (fixing the space-separated `2026-08-06 07:35` format on `podcasts.md`), flag invalid `created` with an amber badge, and omit cleanly on the 80.6% of card notes where `created` is absent (Week/Quarter/Year, Zorg dailies, legacy records). 3. **1:1 drawer completeness without noise**: summarize nested mappings (`record:` on Albums, `bank:` on `bank.md`) as compact structural rows with a 1-click/`==` jump, subtly badge card-rendered keys (`in card`), and tuck historical Zorg migration keys (`generated_from_zorg`, `zorg_*`) behind a secondary sub-fold (`▸ 7 migration keys`). 4. **Make `=+` work vault-wide across all Markdown notes** (while keeping `=-` scoped strictly to notes with a mounted property card), and add a Reading-view `=` prefix window + Command Palette commands + card footer controls so `==`/`=-`/`=+` work outside Live Preview too. 5. **Include `bank.md` immediately** in whole-container hiding and the shared footer while leaving its eventual migration from body-mount to title-slot decoupled. 6. **Strict fail-open invariants**: never hide `.metadata-container` on malformed YAML, Source mode, embeds, hover popovers, Canvas, Print, mobile, or failed mounts; leave the right-sidebar File Properties pane untouched. ### Recommended Solution - **Whole-Container Hiding**: Replace `240b`'s per-row `MutationObserver` (`subtree: true`) with a scope-level class (`bob-property-card-owns-properties`) backed by a Live Preview `StateField` (`EditorView.editorAttributes`, mirroring `240i`) and direct-child CSS (`display: none !important`), keeping `.metadata-container` in the DOM so `240e` title-slot anchoring continues working cleanly. Route `241d`'s `notebookFocusSummaryProperty` to `=+` when `.metadata-container` is card-owned. - **Generalized `=` Chord Dispatcher**: Extend `248m-plugin-schema-double-equals.js` (since Vim treats `=` as `indentAuto` and `obsidian_vimrc.md` cannot bind `=-`/`=+`) to dispatch `==`, `=-`, and `=+` in capture phase — allowing `shiftKey` for `+`, rejecting counts/registers/Source/Insert/Visual/Replace, and adding an 800 ms Reading-view prefix window. - **Hybrid Write Engine (Zero `bob-cli` breaking changes for v1)**: - **Verified JS Line-Span YAML Writer** (mirroring `bob-cli`'s `src/native/yaml_spans.rs` rules — never `processFrontMatter`): preserves BOM, CRLF, comments, quoting, and `bank.md` flow maps; refuses duplicate keys and anchors/tags; verifies every edit with `parseYaml()` round-trip checks; commits via `editor.replaceRange` (instant UI + native Undo) or preimage-guarded `vault.process` + in-modal multi-step Undo (`u` / `Ctrl+Z`). - **`app.metadataTypeManager`** for global `.obsidian/types.json` property types (with an explicit timezone-loss warning if converting `created` away from `text`). - **1-key `=` handoff** to existing Rust-backed `==` domain editors for `record:`/`bank:`/schema-managed fields, **`y` YAML excursion** with `242e`'s floating `Done` pill, **`proseField` v2 (`S16`)** + `bob-emoji`, and `Esc`/`q`/`Ctrl+[` close keys via `241xc`.
